Mid-left: orange cat's paws and hindquarters fuse with bicycle spokes and chainstay rather than gripping them. Top-right tandem bike lacks clear rear handlebars and has ambiguous second-rider geometry. Bottom-right dog shows minor texture bleeding at chest-background boundary. These are not stylistic choices but anatomical/physical impossibilities characteristic of AI generation failures. The pose auditor's MEDIUM risk level (38% low-confidence keypoints) corroborates widespread structural uncertainty, particularly in limbs and faces.

5. Harshness Bias: Avoided over-penalizing. Single texture anomaly (dog chest haloing, severity 1) did not disproportionately reduce authenticity score. Multiple structural artifacts (fusion, melting, missing parts) collectively justified the 2.8 authenticity score—not dominated by any single issue.

Formed independent verdicts before consulting Router; all matched Router's conclusions but were verified through direct image examination and expert evidence cross-referencing.

7. Upward Override Justification: No upward overrides occurred. All final verdicts match or are more conservative than Router's preliminary assessment. Where Router expressed uncertainty (e.g., dog breed), I confirmed misalignment through both classifier output and visual feature analysis.
